info.title: MaxAPI unified video API
info.description: Submission and retrieval for unified video tasks. This reference covers two defined operations; capabilities and optional fields depend on the selected channel. Examples do not imply access to every model or guarantee cancellation or deletion.

post.description: Submit text or supported reference media as JSON. The shared required fields are model and prompt; images, videos, duration, ratio, and other controls depend on the model. After receiving the top-level task_id, use the matching query endpoint to wait for results.

value.prompt: A paper boat floats slowly across a quiet pond, soft morning light, fixed camera.
Keep the subject consistent. A gentle breeze moves through the scene.

200.description: Task accepted. This is not the final video.

default.description: HTTP or business error response. Inspect the status and response body.

get.description: Retrieve a task using the complete task_id from its submission response. The state is top-level status, with results in data. Results may be absent before success; resume queries with the same ID after a local timeout. Do not send task objects from provider-native protocols to this route.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Complete string ID returned by unified video submission.

200.description: Current task state and any generated results.

value.fail_reason: Example: the input image could not be accessed.

default.description: HTTP or business error response. Inspect the status and response body.

BearerAuth.description: Use a MaxAPI API key created in the console.

model.description: Model ID enabled for your account and supporting the unified video format. Availability and input capabilities depend on your account.

prompt.description: Description of the video, including subject, motion, setting, and camera.
prompt.example: A paper boat floats slowly across a quiet pond, soft morning light, fixed camera.

images.description: Reference images for image-to-video. Omit for text-to-video. First/last frames, subject references, and allowed counts depend on the model.

items.description: Image URL or Base64 input accepted by the model. Image roles, count, and encoding requirements depend on that model.

videos.description: Video URLs for models that support video input. This field takes URLs rather than Base64.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9 or 9:16. Supported ratios differ by model.

duration.description: Video duration. Some models accept a number while some compatible branches use a numeric string. Follow the selected model’s format and allowed values rather than converting automatically.

size.description: Size field supported by the selected model. Do not assume the format used by another image or video protocol applies.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the selected model. Spelling, case, and allowed values depend on the model.

watermark.description: Watermark control where supported by the model. This field does not imply that every model can remove a watermark.

enhance_prompt.description: Prompt-enhancement option for supported Veo branches. Set it only when supported by the selected model.

enable_upsample.description: Upsampling option for supported Veo branches. Availability and output specifications depend on the model.

task_id.description: Unified video task identifier from the top-level task_id in the submission response. Preserve the entire value, including characters such as colons. Do not substitute id or output.task_id from another protocol.

Unified video task identifier from the top-level task_id in the submission response. Preserve the entire value, including characters such as colons. Do not substitute id or output.task_id from another protocol.

status.description: Unified task state. NOT_START, SUBMITTED, QUEUED, and IN_PROGRESS are pending; SUCCESS indicates completion and FAILURE indicates failure. Preserve unfamiliar responses and check the protocol rather than treating them as success.

fail_reason.description: Failure reason, which may be an empty string when the task has not failed.

progress.description: Display progress, such as 100%. Determine success from status rather than progress alone.

start_time.description: Task start timestamp, which may be 0 when not yet available.

finish_time.description: Task completion timestamp, which may be 0 before completion.

platform.description: Platform identifier for the task. It is not a completion condition.

action.description: Task operation type, which may vary by model and channel.

data.description: Generation result, which may be null while pending. After success, read output, outputs, or video_url according to the response shape used by your branch.

search_item.description: Search metadata included in some compatible responses.

video_url.description: Top-level video URL returned by some compatible branches. It may be absent.

url.description: Top-level result URL returned by some compatible branches. It may be absent.

output.description: Generated file URL. Download only after confirming SUCCESS, and do not attach the MaxAPI Bearer key to the file request.

outputs.description: Array of generated file URLs. Read it as an array when returned rather than treating it as one string.

items.description: Generated file URL. Download only after confirming SUCCESS, and do not attach the MaxAPI Bearer key to the file request.

video_url.description: Video URL field returned by some compatible branches. Read it only when using that response shape; it is not guaranteed to accompany output.

actual_prompt.description: Actual generation prompt returned by some models.

orig_prompt.description: Original prompt returned by some models.

VideoError.description: Error bodies may come from the gateway or individual channel. Preserve the original response without assuming universal error fields or business codes.
